author: Tzleaf
quote:
The critic score on this game proves that Metacritic is, without a doubt, bought and paid for. No longer will I rely on this site as a reputable resource.

For starters, the optimization and performance of this game is appalling. Even on a PS5 Pro, you’re lucky to get a steady 30 fps, as the frame-rate often dips BELOW that. This isn’t excusable in 2026 when systems cost as much as they do. If you decide to play regardless of the frame-rate, I hope you don’t mind motion sickness.

Second, this is just another GTA. There is nothing truly innovative, and if anything, I’ve found that the story is worse than previous entries. Jason and Lucia are incredibly vapid characters, almost as though they’ve been plucked right off of a throwaway Netflix reality show. It saddens me to imagine this as an entry point for those unfamiliar with gaming.

Furthermore, it is shameful that GTA 6 has received so many Game of the Year nominations (across nearly every category) when the game was JUST released. This game has a mythical status around it because of the long awaited hype, sure. But it really feels like the developers and marketing team are just cashing out on years of success from previous titles, without giving us anything substantive.

tldr: All budget and hype, no substance.
